An identification with Antoni Prusimski was proposed through Pachoński's PSB entry and ruled out by the editor (2026-11-01), the evidence exhausted in hand - the entry gives its sources only as a list, with nothing tying the manuscript to any claim; its quoted wording does not appear in the copy; the codex's own index names no addressee; the library's catalogue record describes the contents no further than its title. Only new evidence (the original, a second copy, new scholarship) could reopen it
